mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE loc_tree AS ( SELECT id, household_id, parent_id, name, sort_order, status, updated_at, name::TEXT AS path FROM location WHERE household_id = #{householdId} AND parent_id IS NULL AND updated_at > #{cursor} UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.household_id, c.parent_id, c.name, c.sort_order, c.status, c.updated_at, (p.path || '>' || c.name) FROM location c JOIN loc_tree p ON c.parent_id = p.id WHERE c.updated_at > #{cursor} ) SELECT id AS location_id, household_id, parent_id, name, path, sort_order, status, updated_at FROM loc_tree ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
